title: Advance Variation (3.e5)
intro: White pushes 3.e5 to grab space. Strike the base of the pawn chain with 3...c5, pile up on d4 with ...Nc6 and ...Qb6, and avoid traps.

steps.text: In the Advance Variation, White's d4 and e5 pawns form a chain. Black attacks the base on d4 right away.
Strike at the base of the pawn chain.
steps.ifRight: This is the core idea of the French Defence.

steps.text: Add a second attacker to d4.
steps.ifWrong: Play 4...Nc6 to pressure d4 and control e5.
steps.ifRight: Now d4 is under pressure from two Black units.

steps.text: Add a third attacker to d4 and hit b2 at the same time.
steps.ifWrong: Play 5...Qb6 to pressure both d4 and b2.
steps.ifRight: Now White must choose between 6.Be2, 6.Bd3 and 6.a3.

steps.text: White plays 6.a3, preparing b4. Stop White's queenside plan or increase the pressure.
steps.hint: Lock down the queenside with ...c4, or develop ...Nh6 to f5.
steps.ifWrong: Play 6...c4 (or 6...Nh6 or 6...Bd7): 6...c4 shuts down White's b4 push and clamps the queenside.

lessons.title: Meeting 6.Bd3
lessons.summary: Play ...cxd4 and ...Bd7 before capturing on d4.

steps.text: With 6.Bd3, White leaves d4 lightly defended, setting a famous trap.
Trade pawns on d4 so White's d4 pawn becomes a fixed target.
steps.ifRight: Now watch out for the trick after 7.cxd4.

steps.text: Do not grab d4 yet because 7...Nxd4 8.Nxd4 Qxd4 walks into 9.Bb5+. Block the check first.
steps.hint: Put your c8 bishop on d7.
steps.ifWrong: Play 7...Bd7 so ...Nxd4 is a real threat next.

steps.text: White castles: 8.O-O, offering the Milner-Barry Gambit.
Grab the central pawn now that Bb5+ is impossible.
steps.hint: Capture on d4 with your c6 knight.
steps.ifWrong: Play 8...Nxd4: after 9.Nxd4 Qxd4, Black wins a central pawn safely.
steps.ifRight: Black wins a healthy central pawn and meets ...Qxd4 cleanly.

lessons.title: Meeting 4.dxc5 and 4.Nf3
lessons.summary: Develop ...Nc6 and ...Bxc5 against 4.dxc5, and trade on d4 against 4.Nf3.

steps.text: Instead of 4.c3, White sometimes gives up the centre with 4.dxc5.
Develop with an attack on e5 before taking back on c5.
steps.hint: Bring your queen's knight to c6, hitting e5.
steps.ifWrong: Play 4...Nc6 (or 4...Bxc5) to put immediate pressure on e5.
steps.ifRight: White must spend time guarding e5 while you win c5 back smoothly.

steps.text: Recover the pawn and develop your bishop.
steps.hint: Capture on c5 with your dark-squared bishop.
steps.ifRight: Black has an easy game with ...f6 or ...Nge7 next.

steps.ifWrong: Play 4...cxd4 so White cannot build the c3-d4 chain.
steps.ifRight: After 5.Nxd4 Nc6 (or 5.Qxd4 Nc6), Black gets fast piece play.

steps.text: White recaptured 5.Nxd4. Continue challenging White's centre.
steps.hint: Develop your queen's knight to c6.
steps.ifWrong: Play 5...Nc6 to attack d4 and e5.
steps.ifRight: Black follows with ...Qb6 or ...Bc5 with strong pressure.
